2609.11739.title: LOCUS: Task-Aware Low-Rank Post-Training for Token-Efficient Language Generation
2609.11739.paper_summary: Large language model serving costs scale directly with output sequence length, yet standard preference alignment often inflates response verbosity without improving utility. We study whether the parameterization of post-training updates affects generation length: low-rank subspaces alter sequence length without modifying the alignment loss. We present LOCUS, a method that selects a task-aware low-rank adaptation subspace to minimize output-token cost subject to a utility constraint. Within this subspace, post-training retains the native preference objective with a frozen backbone. Across Anthropic HH-RLHF dialogue preferences, we evaluate two $\sim$3B decoder backbones, Pythia-2.8B and Qwen2.5-3B, against protocol-matched full-parameter DPO and DrDPO branches and the released SamPO checkpoint. LOCUS reduces continuation length by up to 39.84\% on Pythia-2.8B and by 14.87--17.58\% on Qwen2.5-3B while updating only 0.24--0.28\% of model parameters, with no material change in the internal preference diagnostic.
2609.11739.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型的服務成本與輸出序列長度直接相關，但標準的偏好對齊往往會增加回應的冗長性，而不改善實用性。我們研究後訓練更新的參數化是否會影響生成長度：低秩子空間在不修改對齊損失的情況下改變序列長度。我們提出了LOCUS，一種選擇任務感知低秩適應子空間的方法，以最小化在實用性約束下的輸出標記成本。在這個子空間內，後訓練保留了原生的偏好目標，同時凍結了主幹。在Anthropic HH-RLHF對話偏好中，我們評估了兩個約3B的解碼器主幹，Pythia-2.8B和Qwen2.5-3B，與協議匹配的全參數DPO和DrDPO分支以及已發布的SamPO檢查點進行比較。LOCUS在Pythia-2.8B上將延續長度減少了最多39.84\%，在Qwen2.5-3B上減少了14.87--17.58\%，同時僅更新了0.24--0.28\%的模型參數，內部偏好診斷沒有實質性變化。
2609.11739.author: Dongfang Zhao et.al.
